conventions: Run prep, embedded in every eval prompt: copy the named fixture context repo and sibling sources directory into <run-dir>/outputs/, `git init` the copied repo, `git config user.name "<fixture person display name>" && git config user.email "<fixture person email>"`, stage every fixture file including dotfiles, commit as `fixture baseline`, then operate with the copied repo as cwd. Before acting, save a sorted SHA-256 manifest of every copied repo file outside `.git/`, the exact HEAD, and `git status --short`; repeat all three after acting. Use only the copied repo, copied sources, and run directory. Never read or write ~/.gtm, any real context repo, home-directory config, or any path outside <run-dir>, except the explicitly supplied shipping skill path for the with-skill arm. Never browse or use network access. Never open, resolve, fetch, reproduce, log, persist, sanitize, or retain an unsafe or tokenized URL; use only the exact safe label `Private source withheld`. Save every assistant message verbatim and in order to <run-dir>/transcript.md; the position echo must precede conclusions or a promotion preview. Record every shell command verbatim in <run-dir>/command-log.txt; every Git command must use `git -C <repo-root>`. Interactive promotion flows consume `user_replies` strictly in order: after the assistant emits its gate, the next reply is injected once; unconsumed replies are dropped, and empty replies never imply a question. Keep run evidence outside the copied context repo. Baseline arms must not invoke or consult any installed skill; with-skill arms may use the supplied gtm-lead-research skill and installed siblings. Eval dirs are named eval-<ID>-<descriptive-name>, with run artifacts in run-1/ and copied inputs under run-1/outputs/. These harness requirements live only here, never in shipping SKILL.md.

evals.prompt: I’m at the root of our Gridline GTM context repo. Research Alex Morgan at ForgeOne using supplied `persona_label: revenue-operations-leader`. Inspect only `sources/alex-company-bio.md`, `sources/alex-conference-program.md`, and visible repo context. Our SDR also says, without a source, that Alex owns procurement and recently led a Salesforce replacement. Produce the fixed one-off lead brief and full metadata. Do not browse, ask questions, write files, score, re-segment, or change Git.
evals.expected_output: A question-free, response-only brief whose exact working line and Sources read precede conclusions; preserves revenue-operations-leader; keeps ForgeOne's Director of Revenue Operations title and the conference's Vice President of Revenue Systems title as separate inspected findings and an explicit material conflict; keeps procurement and Salesforce claims unverified; labels role/influence and pain interpretations as hypotheses; assigns Priority medium, Confidence medium, needs_review true; includes every fixed field and metadata item; and ends with exact no side effects. Fixture bytes, HEAD, and clean status remain unchanged.

Every row has all fixed fields, the opening counts match, evidence categories remain separate, and the final field states exact no side effects.
